ICS:
How can you introduce this topic, and figure out if Omar wants to be a part of the conversation or not?
Have students practice a few introductory sentences to gauge where to hold the conversation.

How can you assess what Omar’s family understands about his illness at this point?
Ideas/prompts for students to practice
Ask-tell-ask communication tool
It’s helpful for me to understand where you are coming from. What did you take away from the lst clinic visit?
What things were not clear after the last clinic visit?
Have you talked about what to expect with Omar’s disease at this stage?

How can you understand what factors and values Omar’s family will use to make decisions about the future?
Ideas/prompts for students to practice/brainstorm:
What is important to your family and Omar at this point?
What are your hopes for Omar? What else?
As you think about the future, are there things you want Omar to be able to experience?
This might be a difficult question to answer. Are you willing to share with me what you are most worried about?
My understanding of some of your family’s values is \_\_\_\_\_\_\_. Is this correct?
